claudomat 1.0.0
USAGE:
    claudomat [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    claudomat run "fix the auth bug" --budget 5.00
    claudomat batch tasks.json --budget 50.00
    claudomat boards "https://dev.azure.com/org/project" --budget 20.00 --working-dir ./repos
    claudomat pr 42 "Review this PR." --repo-url https://dev.azure.com/org/proj/_git/repo --working-dir ./pr-src --budget 5.00

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    run <prompt>                     Run a single prompt through Claude Code with budget tracking and rate limit handling                                                                               
    batch <tasks-file>               Run multiple tasks from a JSON file with shared budget tracking                                                                                                    
    boards <project-url>             Find Agentic-tagged epics in an Azure DevOps project, clone repos as needed, and run Claude on approved work items                                                 
    pr <pull-request-id> <prompt>    Run one Claude Code session scoped to a pull request (claude --from-pr). Clones/syncs the PR source from Azure DevOps when a PAT is set (not from pipeline branch  
                                     variables)

claudomat 1.0.0
DESCRIPTION:
Run a single prompt through Claude Code with budget tracking and rate limit handling

USAGE:
    claudomat run <prompt> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    claudomat run "fix the auth bug" --budget 5.00

ARGUMENTS:
    <prompt>    The prompt to send to Claude

OPTIONS:
                                        DEFAULT                                                                                                                                                     
    -h, --help                                     Prints help information                                                                                                                          
        --budget                        0          Maximum budget in USD (0 = no limit)                                                                                                             
        --max-turns                                Maximum number of agentic turns                                                                                                                  
        --max-retries                   10         Maximum retry attempts on rate limit                                                                                                             
        --model                                    Claude model to use (e.g. sonnet, opus)                                                                                                          
        --working-dir                              Working directory for Claude                                                                                                                     
        --allowed-tools                            Allowed (or disallowed) tools, actions, and commands. Can be specified multiple times (e.g. --allowed-tools "Bash(git:*)" --allowed-tools "Edit")
        --exclude-branch                           Skip when the source branch matches a glob (* wildcard); default includes renovate/* (repeatable)

result.stdout:
claudomat 1.0.0
DESCRIPTION:
Run multiple tasks from a JSON file with shared budget tracking

USAGE:
    claudomat batch <tasks-file> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    claudomat batch tasks.json --budget 50.00

ARGUMENTS:
    <tasks-file>    Path to the batch tasks JSON file

OPTIONS:
                                        DEFAULT                                                                                                            
    -h, --help                                     Prints help information                                                                                 
        --budget                        0          Maximum total budget in USD across all tasks (0 = no limit)                                             
        --max-retries                   10         Default maximum retry attempts on rate limit (per task)                                                 
        --working-dir                              Default working directory for tasks that don't specify one                                              
        --allowed-tools                            Default allowed (or disallowed) tools for tasks that don't specify them. Can be specified multiple times
        --exclude-branch                           Skip batch when default working-dir branch matches a glob; default includes renovate/* (repeatable)     
        --source-branch                            Override branch for exclude check when using default working-dir                                        
        --no-default-branch-excludes               Do not add renovate/*; only --exclude-branch patterns apply                                             
        --permission                               Default permission: omit for auto; 'unsafe' for --dangerously-skip-permissions                          
        --timeout                       30         Default task timeout in minutes (0 = no timeout, default 30)                                            
        --azdo-pat                                 Azur
[truncated]

                                        DEFAULT                                                                                                                      
    -h, --help                                     Prints help information                                                                                           
        --budget                        0          Maximum budget in USD for all work items combined (0 = no limit)                                                  
        --working-dir                              Working directory (target repo root)                                                                              
        --model                                    Claude model to use                                                                                               
        --max-turns                                Maximum agentic turns per work item                                                                               
        --max-retries                   10         Maximum retry attempts per work item on rate limit                                                                
        --allowed-tools                            Allowed tools (repeatable)                                                                                        
        --exclude-branch                           Skip when working-dir branch matches a glob; default includes renovate/* (repeatable)                             
        --source-branch                            Override branch for exclude check
